P01.rationale: A large portrait of a person fills roughly half the left column, serving as a strong human anchor, though it functions more as a case-study client image than a dedicated founder portrait.

P05.rationale: The client (Niklas Klein) is shown in a large, named video-still portrait that occupies a substantial portion of the left column, clearly identified with name and company below.

P07.rationale: A single attributed testimonial quote is present on the right column, but there is no logo wall, rating cards, or review grid to constitute a fuller social-proof apparatus.

P10.rationale: No oversized ghost numerals or large decorative quote glyphs are used; the large numbers on the right are data metrics, not decorative typographic elements.

P11.rationale: Three bold metric figures (16+ Std., 45, 3 Monate) are clearly bound to specific outcome numbers, functioning as before/after data anchors, though no charts or cost-math visualisations are present.

P12.rationale: The layout is reasonably well-filled with a large image, structured text sections, and metric callouts, but the right column has notable open space below the testimonial that prevents a fully dense editorial feel.

P13.rationale: A very subtle warm off-white background is used, but there is no meaningful texture or atmospheric treatment beyond a plain tinted ground.

P14.rationale: The video-still portrait has overlaid text (+16 Stunden Ar… pro Kunde) that is legible against a darkened background area within the image, suggesting intentional contrast treatment.

P16.rationale: No phone, laptop, book, or product mockup is shown anywhere on the page.

N07.rationale: The portrait appears to be a real branded video still with a logo overlay, giving it some specificity, though the background setting is fairly generic office/exterior.

N08.rationale: The lower half of the right column is largely empty below the testimonial block, creating a significant dead-whitespace region that weakens the layout density.

N10.rationale: The text overlay on the video still is partially readable but the '+16 Stunden Ar…' text is cut off and sits on a moderately busy image area without a full scrim, causing minor legibility issues.
